description: This file sets up a Streamlit-based web interface for a SQL database chatbot, integrating LangChain components for querying a PostgreSQL database with OpenAI models, and includes functions for token counting and user interaction.

methods.name: count_tokens
methods.description: Counts tokens for a given chain and query, combining a prompt template with the user query, and executes the chain while tracking token usage.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Runs the Streamlit app for user interaction with the SQL database chatbot, managing chat history and processing user queries.
